where.if: AND (request_uri LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '/' OR operator_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '/' OR operator_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '/' OR trace_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '/')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_operation_log (id, module, operation, request_method, request_uri, query_string, operator_id, operator_name, operator_ip, result, status_code, cost_ms, trace_id, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{module}, #{operation}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUri}, #{queryString}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorIp}, #{result}, #{statusCode}, #{costMs}, #{traceId}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT id, module, operation, request_method AS requestMethod, request_uri AS requestUri, query_string AS queryString, operator_id AS operatorId, operator_name AS operatorName, operator_ip AS operatorIp, result, status_code AS statusCode, cost_ms AS costMs, trace_id AS traceId, create_time AS createTime FROM t_operation_log
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
